cycles.root_cause: OECD non-EU countries (Japan, Australia, S.Korea) with standard macro indicators (unemployment, GDP) were routed to OECD which has unreliable indicator resolution. UnifiedRouter rule at line 926 matched too broadly.
cycles.fix_description: 1) Split OECD routing into OECD-specific indicators (R&D, Gini, tax) vs standard macro (GDP, unemployment). Standard macro → WorldBank for OECD non-EU countries. 2) Added prefetch fallback: when primary provider indicator resolution fails, try fallback providers before giving up. 3) Simple single-country macro queries bypass orchestrator for deterministic pipeline. 4) Added 3 new benchmark queries (acc-09, acc-10, cov-07).
cycles.note: acc-02 routing now correct (WorldBank not OECD), but WorldBank indicator resolution for 'unemployment rate' still fails — needs indicator resolution quality improvement in next cycle
